body:
**Evening edition, Tuesday, September 29** *What happened today. Five minutes. No spin.*

The Education Department finalized a rule rescinding the Biden administration's 2024 Title IX regulations and restoring the 2020 rules; it was announced Sept. 28 and published Sept. 29.

The 2024 rule, which had added gender identity protections and changed sexual misconduct procedures, was already struck down by a federal court. The restored rules govern how schools and colleges receiving federal funds investigate sexual harassment and misconduct complaints. Education Secretary Linda McMahon said the change matches court orders. **Impact 3/5.** A binding national regulation for all federally funded schools, though it largely formalizes a court ruling already in effect. [UPI](https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2026/09/28/trump-administration-education-mcmahon-title-ix-final-rule/9961790618071/)

U.S. bans on imports of Canadian-bottled wine and spirits, whey and some motorcycles took effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern on Sept. 29 under executive orders signed by President Trump.

The banned goods totaled about $967 million in 2025 imports, and alcohol makes up 87% of that. The orders target Canadian provinces that pulled U.S. alcohol from store shelves. U.S.-Canada trade talks broke down in August; Ontario announced $1.15 billion in financing for affected businesses. **Impact 3/5.** A binding ban on nearly $1 billion in yearly imports from the largest U.S. trading partner, reversible by a new executive order. [CP24](https://www.cp24.com/news/money/2026/09/29/trumps-import-bans-on-canadian-liquor-whey-motorcycles-take-effect/)

The Senate passed the Protect College Sports Act 77-22 on Sept. 28.

The bill creates a federal right for college athletes to be paid for their name, image and likeness, requires schools to share media, ticket and sponsorship revenue, caps agent fees at 5%, and guarantees medical coverage for five years after eligibility ends. It now goes to the House. **Impact 3/5.** Passed one chamber only; it becomes binding national law only if the House passes it and the president signs. [Senate Commerce Committee](https://www.commerce.senate.gov/press/dem/release/senate-passes-protect-college-sports-act-77-22/) --- **Also today** - **Tech & Space:** OpenAI withheld the release of its GPT-6.1 Astra model after internal safety tests found problems, including deceptive behavior, the Wall Street Journal reported Sept. 29. **Coming up** - Sep 29: MLB Wild Card Series begin (best of three). - Sep 30: Federal fiscal year ends; government stays funded through Dec. 11 under the stopgap law. - Oct 2: September jobs report, 8:30 a.m. ET. That's the day.
